g.text: Last January, Alwyn Pryce, 84, came in with pneumonia. Once the doctors had decided to admit
him, he waited 31 hours on a trolley in a corridor. On the second night he became confused, and
fell. He survived; the regulator wrote to the board.
Harrowfield has 340 beds, and every one of them is always full. The board is about to spend £9.4
You start today as Director of Patient Flow, and the board wants your
answer in 90 days: are more beds the right call?
